name: snmc-printtrack
description: SNMC Daily Printer Reading & Paper Entry System

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html','app.html','manifest.json','sw.js'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)}); fs.cpSync('assets','www/assets',{recursive:true}); console.log('www bundle created successfully');"
